{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing age values (value -1)
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age = -1: {sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check revenue column for string format
print(f"First few revenue values: {sales['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]}")

# Check if channel is balanced across segments
print("\nChannel distribution by segment:")
print(sales.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
